svg.title: LLM Inference Engine — 74.14 tok/s, 1,630 kernels to one CUDA Graph

g.text: (LLM Inference Engine · C++ · Triton · CUDA · PyTorch)
Qwen2.5-3B · 4-bit · RTX 4060 8GB · from scratch — no HuggingFace, no vLLM
decode step, before · 1,630 Triton kernel launches per token · ~45µs each
decode step, after · captured in a single CUDA Graph · device-side KV indexing
memory-coalesced Triton kernels · custom C++/CUDA RMSNorm extension
